turns.query: Lesson 06 ki teen clips, movement aur total reel duration samjhao.

request_body.message: Lesson 06 ki teen clips, movement aur total reel duration samjhao.

history.content: Lesson 06 ki teen clips, movement aur total reel duration samjhao.

Lesson 06, 'Dukaan Ki Photos Se Video' mein, aap teen alag-alag clips banana seekhte hain, har clip mein ek specific movement hoti hai, aur in sab ko jodkar ek 18-second ki reel banti hai.

Yahan details hain:

*   **Teen Clips:**
    1.  **Shop Front:** Isme camera dheere se dukaan ke darwaze ki taraf 'push' karta hai. (Lesson 06)
    2.  **Andar:** Is clip mein camera andar counter ki taraf 'glide' karta hai, jaise koi customer andar chal raha ho. (Lesson 06)
    3.  **Food:** Isme camera plate ke around halka sa 'circle' karta hai. (Lesson 06)

*   **Movement:** Har clip mein sirf ek dheema camera movement hota hai. Jaise, shop front ke liye 'push', andar ke liye 'glide', aur food ke liye 'halka circle'. (Lesson 06)

*   **Total Reel Duration:** Teeno 6-second clips ko CapCut mein jodkar ek 18-second ki reel banayi jaati hai. (Lesson 06)

Is lesson mein yeh bhi sikhaya gaya hai ki prompt mein saaf likho ki kya badalna hai aur kya bilkul nahi badalna, taaki video mein board ka text ya menu ke daam bigde nahi. (Lesson 06)

turns.query: Lesson 10 ka final project aur teen honest marketing rules batao.

request_body.message: Lesson 10 ka final project aur teen honest marketing rules batao.

history.content: Lesson 10 ka final project aur teen honest marketing rules batao.

Lesson 10, yaani 'Finale', mein aapka final project hai ek asli dukaan (maalik se poochh ke) ke liye poora marketing set banana. Ismein yeh sab shamil hoga:

*   Ek business brief
*   Do photo upgrade
*   Ek food/product photo
*   Ek offer poster
*   Ek awaaz wali reel
*   Ek hafte ka posting plan

Yeh sab banane ke baad, aapko maalik ko dikhana hoga.

Teen honest marketing rules jo Lesson 10 mein sikhaye gaye hain, woh hain:

1.  **Asli photo:** Hamesha asli photos use karo.
2.  **Asli daam:** Jo daam dikha rahe ho, woh asli hona chahiye.
3.  **Har post maalik ki manzoori se:** Koi bhi post karne se pehle dukaan ke maalik ki permission zaroor lo.

request_body.message: Business name: Narmada Bakery; Area/city: Palasia, Indore; Menu: bread, cookies; Timings: 9 AM–8 PM. Sirf ye facts yaad rakho.

history.content: Business name: Narmada Bakery; Area/city: Palasia, Indore; Menu: bread, cookies; Timings: 9 AM–8 PM. Sirf ye facts yaad rakho.

Theek hai, Narmada Bakery ke facts yaad hain: Palasia, Indore mein hai, bread aur cookies milte hain, aur timings 9 AM se 8 PM hain.

Ab aap AI Local Business Ads course ke baare mein kuch pooch sakte hain, ya platform se related koi help chahiye toh batao.
Lesson 08 ke caption mein meri business details use karo; koi offer ya price invent mat karo.

Lesson 08 mein Instagram caption ke liye aapki business details use karke ek draft yahan hai, bina koi offer ya price invent kiye:

**Instagram Caption Draft:**

"Narmada Bakery Palasia, Indore mein aapka swagat hai! Fresh bread aur delicious cookies ke liye aaj hi visit karein. Hum subah 9 baje se raat 8 baje tak open rehte hain.
